transcript-first-data-model--external-pr.label: Provider Server
transcript-first-data-model--external-pr.description: Anthropic / OpenAI / Moonshot — remote provider infrastructure outside Novakai

transcript-first-data-model--ingestion-t.label: Ingestion
transcript-first-data-model--ingestion-t.description: the ONLY code that reads provider files. Per tick: stat; unchanged = read nothing; grown = seek to offset, read tail only; signature mismatch = recalibrate that one file, uuid dedupe keeps it safe

transcript-first-data-model--send-and-de.label: One-shot CLI Send
transcript-first-data-model--send-and-de.description: claude -p --resume / codex exec resume / kimi -p -S; one send = one child process

transcript-first-data-model--send-and-de.label: Delivery Router
transcript-first-data-model--send-and-de.description: delivers pending items into the recipient's session ONLY when idle, batched at turn boundaries — children never interrupt a parent

transcript-first-data-model--external-pr.label: Provider CLI Process
transcript-first-data-model--external-pr.description: Local provider-owned child process. Invokes the registered Novakai hook, communicates with the provider server, and writes the provider session file.

transcript-first-data-model--transcript-.label: Target shape, entity notation. One door in: Ingestion is the only reader of provider files. Transcript Line is the single root; projections rebuild from it. Acceptance test: delete a provider session file, restart, nothing changes.

transcript-first-data-model--root-store-.label: Root store — single source of truth

transcript-first-data-model--ingestion-t.label: Provider Transcript Adapters
transcript-first-data-model--ingestion-t.description: Claude, Codex and Kimi parsers that recognise each provider's persisted Novakai hook representation and emit normalized {sessionId, agentId} evidence.

transcript-first-data-model--ingestion-t.label: Session Assignment
transcript-first-data-model--ingestion-t.description: Consumes explicit {sessionId, agentId} evidence and fills the existing Provider Session agentId FK. Agent creation is owned by a separate future process.

transcript-first-data-model--send-and-de.label: Novakai Agent Identity Hook
transcript-first-data-model--send-and-de.description: Novakai-owned UserPromptSubmit hook. Receives the Agent ID supplied by sendMessage, emits it when invoked by the provider CLI, and causes it to be persisted in the provider session file.

transcript-first-data-model--wire-1.label: writes provider transcript and hook output

transcript-first-data-model--wire-7.label: registers each discovered session; agentId empty if external

transcript-first-data-model--wire-8.label: fill agentId FK from explicit evidence

transcript-first-data-model--wire-11.label: spawns sub-agents via our CLI; parent-child

transcript-first-data-model--wire-15.label: spawn or resume the provider CLI

transcript-first-data-model--wire-20.label: reply addressed to another agent queues here

transcript-first-data-model--wire-24.label: participantIds — agents, or you; never empty

transcript-first-data-model--wire-25.label: creates a send row — same path as you

transcript-first-data-model--wire-27.label: targetSessionId — the session the CLI resumes
